title: Actor Ram Kapoor Reveals Doctor's Warning of Death in Six Months
summary: Actor Ram Kapoor recently revealed that doctors warned him he would die in six months. The warning was made during his time on the reality show 'Lockup Season 2'. Kapoor shared that he had been experiencing depression and was advised to take medication by doctors. He also stated that he had been hiding a significant issue from his wife.
